card.desc: PM condemned Houthi attacks whose victims included Pakistani nationals

caption:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said Pakistan stands "shoulder to shoulder" with Saudi Arabia in protecting its sovereignty and security, Geo News and Dawn reported. Meeting new Saudi Ambassador Dr Rajeh Tami Albugamy in Islamabad, he condemned the recent escalation in Houthi attacks on the kingdom, whose victims included Pakistani nationals.
